title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slips 3.2 percent to 61,962 dollars as fear and greed hits 28, with US morning trade extending the selloff. No major catalysts emerged to reverse the pressure.

Hashrate holds firm at 915 exahashes. Mempool backs up to 96,000 transactions, yet fees sit at just 3 satoshis per vbyte, showing little urgency from spenders. Block height now 957,888.
